title: ICSV 93046 sorghum (ICSV 93 46): Characteristics
metaDescription: ICSV 93046 sorghum is a sweet sorghum OPV variety. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: ICSV 93046 sorghum is a sweet sorghum OPV variety, also sold or known as ICSV 93 46. It is not on the NSIC registry, so the facts here come from its seller and farm sources. It comes from ICRISAT (India), tested in PH by MMSU, DA BAR, UPLB.

heroImage.alt: Young corn seedlings in rows on freshly plowed ground in Bulacan, the kind of farm where ICSV 93046 sorghum is grown

blocks.text: If you came here looking for ICSV 93 46, this is the same sorghum. The facts below come from its seller and from farm sources, each one listed at the end. Compare it with the others in our [sorghum variety finder](/crop-varieties/sorghum), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Land preparation for corn and grains](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

The registry gives no day count or trial yield for this variety. So ask the seller or your municipal agriculturist for figures from farms near you before you plan a season around it.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?
The registry gives no pest or disease ratings for this variety. So treat it as untested, and scout every week.

The pests and diseases that hit sorghum fields most often: [Rice birds (maya)](/pests/rice-birds), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Juicy stalks for sugar and ethanol.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: one of the five ICRISAT sweet sorghum lines found adapted in PH trials, called a commercial variety in a UPLB disease study. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant ICSV 93046 sorghum
Sorghum stands drought better than corn, so it fits the dry season and dry uplands. Pick by use: grain for food and feed, or sweet sorghum for juice and syrup.

items: Buy sealed packs or tagged sacks from an accredited dealer, and check the packing date and germination rate.
Ask your municipal agriculturist or nearby farmers how it did in your area last season.
Try it on a small area first, beside the variety you usually plant, before you switch the whole farm.
Write down the planting day, inputs and harvest, so you can compare varieties on your own ground. anee.io keeps these records for you.

items.q: Is ICSV 93 46 the same as ICSV 93046?
items.a: Yes. ICSV 93 46 is another name for ICSV 93046. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of ICSV 93046?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
